sources.author: 摄影者未署名；原图水印为“中国文化基金会”。新禅风（编辑志斌）转载禅林网图文
sources.date: 网页发布2022-10-05；摄影日期未注明

source_note: 实拍是现址圆觉殿中央主尊近正面，冠顶、双手、莲座及最低台座完整可见。只据此图绘主尊和自有台座，不绘两侧弟子、殿宇外观或其他塑像。照片网站的北魏/401年、元丰三年/1066年等沿革换算错误未采纳，年代使用长治市政府转载《长治日报》的2026年文保说明。所绘彩塑按1111年宋塑主体登记；历代彩绘、修补和现代迁移不能视为原始不变的宋代饰面。外殿1081落架扩建和1984复制外檐不混入这尊像的纪年。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line sculpture illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is STYLE MASTER ONLY: an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Do not copy its facial identity, body, or robe.
Image 2 is the ACTUAL SUBJECT GEOMETRY: a documented straight-on photograph of the CENTRAL seated Shakyamuni Buddha in Yuanjue Hall, Faxing Temple, Zhangzi County, Shanxi, China (长子法兴寺圆觉殿释迦牟尼佛像). Draw only this central original sculpture and its own lotus seat and layered rectangular pedestal, in their current photographed condition. Remove the two smaller standing attendants at the sides, hall walls/beams, carpet, floor, watermark, and every other object.
Preserve the actual crown silhouette and hanging side ribbons, calm rounded face, long ears, the asymmetrical draped robe, crossed legs, the right hand raised toward viewer-left with the actual photographed finger gesture, and the other hand resting on the knee toward viewer-right. Preserve the photographed lotus petals and stepped pedestal silhouette, including its broad upper horizontal ledge with curled ends and recessed middle. Keep ornament selective and sparse; omit painted flowers and paint-surface cracking rather than rendering them as dense texture. Do not replace this figure with a generic Buddha or copy the master figure's hands. Do not invent a halo, weapons, extra fingers, attendants, or temple architecture.
Create a refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident delicate fine contours and a few still finer internal lines for essential drapery, facial features, crown and lotus structure. All surfaces remain WHITE, including hair, eyes, robe, pedestal and recessed spaces. No solid black fill, no grey shading, no hatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient, no color, no gold. The white will become transparent and the ink a dynasty color on the website.
Portrait composition approximately 1024x1536. Center the complete central statue and its own pedestal with the whole crown and lowest base fully visible. Occupy about 80% of canvas height with balanced white breathing room on all sides. Follow the photograph's near frontal orientation, not a newly imagined viewpoint. No text, labels, calligraphy, captions, watermark, frame, or border. This is a present-day illustration of the Song sculpture moved with the temple in the twentieth century, not a reconstruction of the original hall.

generation_history.check: 已用view_image查看实拍与最终输出。保留中央单尊、戴冠、非对称手势、盘腿莲座、分层台座；头冠及台基完整无裁切，背景与侍者移除。线条细疏、黑线白底，无填黑阴影。

historical_sources.title: ·法兴寺·
historical_sources.publisher: 长治市人民政府转载长治日报，2026-05-06
historical_sources.evidence: 圆觉殿1081落架扩建；1916删改外檐，1984依据北宋遗构、营造法式与同类建筑推想复制外檐；全寺1984春至1996秋迁建。殿内宋塑19尊，1111年制作；中央主尊为释迦牟尼，塑匠冯宗本，画匠陈道荣、吕荣。

coordinates.note: Commons长子法兴寺分类页公开现址坐标35°59′04″N,112°54′24″E；寺院级近似位置，不是慈林山旧址或殿内测绘点。

site_recommendation.name: 长子法兴寺
site_recommendation.era: 北宋 · 政和元年宋塑
site_recommendation.yearNote: 取所绘中央释迦牟尼宋塑制作年1111，非寺院创建年或圆觉殿1081扩建年。现址1984—1996迁建，彩塑历代有修补重饰；不把现殿复制外檐当作1081原物。
site_recommendation.place: 山西 · 长子 · 慈林镇翠云山
site_recommendation.lede: 圆觉殿中央的释迦牟尼坐像在莲座上结跏而坐，衣褶与手势仍保留宋塑的从容。图版依现状单绘主尊及台座，记录这批随寺迁移保存的彩塑。

facts.label: 宋塑纪年
facts.text: 殿内宋塑记年为1111年，文献记塑匠冯宗本及画匠陈道荣、吕荣；本图只取中央释迦牟尼像。

facts.label: 殿与像分期
facts.text: 圆觉殿于1081年落架扩建，早于宋塑制作。殿宇、造像与后世重饰各有年代。

facts.label: 迁建保护
facts.text: 寺院1984—1996年迁至翠云山；圆觉殿外檐据北宋遗构推想复制，不能将今天全部外观视为宋代原物。
